instruction: Capture the current video scene as an image and save it as 'space_scene.png' on the Desktop in PNG format.

parameters.window_name: Interstellar Movie - Interstellar Movie - Official Trailer - VLC media player

command: import pyautogui; import time; pyautogui.click({SCREEN_WIDTH_HALF}, {SCREEN_HEIGHT_HALF}); time.sleep(0.5);

metadata.explanation: Task requires capturing a screenshot and saving as PNG format. Evaluator checks: (1) PNG format via PIL, (2) reasonable file size (1KB-50MB), (3) reasonable dimensions (320x240 to 7680x4320), and (4) file creation timestamp is recent (within 5 minutes). These checks prevent cheating with pre-existing files while avoiding impractical content verification.

llm_judge_reasons: Evaluator successfully verifies all practically verifiable aspects: PNG format (via PIL), correct file path (/home/user/Desktop/space_scene.png), reasonable file size (1KB-50MB), reasonable dimensions (320x240 to 7680x4320)
Timestamp verification (file created within 5 minutes) is critical - prevents cheating with pre-existing files and ensures file was created during task execution
The combination of format + size + dimensions + timestamp creates strong evidence that the task was completed correctly
While perfect content verification (confirming the image shows the actual video scene) is impractical, the metadata checks make casual cheating very difficult
Getter correctly extracts image properties using PIL and VM file system commands, metric correctly validates all four checks with appropriate bounds
llm_judge_fix_suggestions: Minor enhancement: Could add aspect ratio validation to ensure dimensions are consistent with typical video formats (16:9, 4:3, etc.)
Optional: Could verify image is not completely blank (e.g., check for some color variation), though this adds complexity
validation.fix_description: Added comprehensive verification: (1) file size bounds (1KB-50MB), (2) dimension bounds (320x240 to 7680x4320), and (3) timestamp verification (file must be created within 5 minutes). These checks prevent cheating with pre-existing or invalid files while remaining practical without full content verification.
